purpose.zh: 拉伸髋前侧，缓解久坐紧张
purpose.en: Stretch the front of your hip to ease tightness from sitting.

text.zh: 骨盆后卷，向前推，拉伸后腿髋前侧
text.en: Tuck your pelvis and shift forward to stretch the front of the back hip

text.zh: 后膝跪地，前脚踩地，上身直立
text.en: Kneel on the back knee, front foot planted, trunk tall.

text.zh: 呼气时稍微加深，腰不往前拱
text.en: Ease a little deeper on each exhale without arching your back.

commonErrors.zh: 腰往前拱代替骨盆后卷
commonErrors.en: Arching the lower back instead of tucking the pelvis.

cautions.zh: 跪地膝下垫软垫；拉伸处疼痛时减小幅度
cautions.en: Pad under the kneeling knee, and ease off if the stretch hurts.
